name: final-reserved-confirmation-20260924
purpose: Explicitly parent-authorized independent reserved confirmation under the unchanged reviewed protocol. Release is limited to these exact 12 families and this frozen 128-cell plan.

release_state.scope: Only the previously reserved 12-family cohort; source data, features, targets, method implementations, split plan, settings and claim gates are unchanged.
execution_conditions: Parent completes final checks and captures the new source/manifest/dependency fingerprint before prepare-only/acquisition.
Live ledger exposure and checksum/schema/class-support gates remain enforced; no alternatives, relabeling, dropping failures or method switches.
No source edits once the final run starts; no LLM, hosted row sharing or expansion of published rights scopes.

reservation_selection_unchanged.algorithm: Four passes of binary/multiclass/regression, taking the next lexicographic eligible family from each nonempty stratum; then repeat the same order over remaining eligible IDs until 12 or exhaustion. No randomness or performance ranking.

preregistration.status_scope: Proposed immutable protocol definition for parent review only; every dataset remains inventory and every registry reservation remains active.

execution_binding_notes.bound_fields: Exact family/method/learner membership, per-family split_plan and expected_cells, shared selection_parameters, seeds, row cap, threads, memory_limit_mb, timeout, budget ceiling, and declared learner grids/middle selection estimators.
execution_binding_notes.method_semantics: Descriptive documentation only; execution.py does not independently validate this object's semantics. The exact method names dispatch the fixed implementations, while archived source/config/manifest/dependency fingerprints bind their identities.
execution_binding_notes.release_markers: release_state and intended_role_after_parent_release are descriptive, not execution authority. Actual inventory roles and ACTIVE catalog reservations block acquisition. Explicit parent release and confirmation admission remain required.
execution_binding_notes.classification_margins: The intended cohort thresholds remain min_total=30, min_outer_train=20, min_outer_test=10. The execution agent's 4/2/2 fixture values are not this scientific protocol.
execution_binding_notes.legacy_dimensions: expected_official_split_dimensions_per_task is retained as source context only; the new split_plan binding ignores it. Source official_split_dimensions remain full 10 repeats x 3 folds x 1 sample.

learner_search.policy: Exactly the existing fixed three-setting inner training-only grid, identically offered to raw/candidate/references. No new model grids or downstream learner switch.

baseline.representation: All reviewed raw predictors, with the unchanged learner-specific training-only preprocessing and fixed three-setting tuning grid.

featcopilot-importance-paired.method_override: This exact existing method always overrides global screening with importance. No per-family/task/learner switch to another method.
featcopilot-importance-paired.importance: Joint fit of the intended learner on retained raw plus candidate columns. Existing normalized absolute coefficients for linear models; LightGBM uses gain importance. Ranking and candidate deduplication occur inside training-only selection boundaries.
featcopilot-importance-paired.candidate_generation: Existing extended numeric rowwise stream and training-frequency categorical-pair indicators; no code changes or new operators.
featcopilot-importance-paired.paired_gain: Existing rule: candidate mean paired loss gain over raw must exceed both 0.001 * baseline loss and paired-gain SE; choose the smallest eligible subset within paired one-SE/0.1%-relative tolerance of the best. Return zero additions if no eligible subset. This built-in raw retention is not post-outcome method switching.
featcopilot-importance-paired.selection_estimator: The existing middle candidate of the same downstream learner's fixed three-setting grid.

openfe-inductive-native.operator_set: Full supported published first-order numeric AND categorical candidate set; no stateless-only restriction.
openfe-inductive-native.statistics: Existing train-only fitted selected DAG operators, applied independently to test batches; not stock transductive openfe.transform.
openfe-inductive-native.search_limitations: Upstream default search on training data is retained; its internal aggregate screening is not presented as cross-fitted statistics.
openfe-inductive-native.resource_policy: External 4096 MiB/900-second limits only; no new operator filtering or failure-to-baseline fallback.

autofeat-native.categorical_handling: Existing training-fitted dense one-hot adapter, unknown levels all zero; original categoricals retained.
autofeat-native.resource_policy: Native max_gb=None; no generation-size-driven subsampling. Native selection-run resampling stays unchanged; only external 4096 MiB/900-second limits apply.
autofeat-native.failure_policy: Do not repair upstream NaNs, drop constants, switch variants or substitute baseline after failure.

preregistration.official_dimensions_scope: The acquired original task still has all 30 official splits. split_plan alone selects exact immutable IDs for this bounded evaluation; source split dimensions and bytes are not rewritten. This legacy top-level dimension declaration is context only and is unused by execution.py on the new split_plan path.
preregistration.expected_cells_formula: (10 official tasks * 1 selected split + 2 IID tasks * 3 folds) * 4 methods * 2 learners * 1 seed
preregistration.class_support_scope: Applied to actual selected official split or all three generated IID folds after explicit release. Previously approved profiles satisfy these thresholds; no payload reinspection occurred in this draft.

decision_and_reporting_plan.primary_units: Original dataset family x learner; each family receives equal weight, regardless of row count or number of scheduled splits.
decision_and_reporting_plan.family_loss: L(f,m,l) is the arithmetic mean of primary loss over ALL preregistered splits for family f, method m, learner l. An incomplete/nonfinite family-method-learner loss is missing, not averaged over surviving folds.
decision_and_reporting_plan.paired_relative_improvement: G(f,reference,l) = 1 - L(f,candidate,l) / L(f,reference,l). Positive is better. Use family-mean losses before taking the ratio.
decision_and_reporting_plan.scale_policy: Report raw family mean/median losses in their task units, but aggregate across heterogeneous families only with normalized paired relative improvements, never unscaled log-loss/RMSE pooling.
decision_and_reporting_plan.mean_and_median: For each task/learner stratum and each comparator, report arithmetic mean and median G across complete paired families, plus the equal-family primary-observational mean/median per learner and worst family harm.
decision_and_reporting_plan.classification_subgroups: Additionally report binary (6 families) and multiclass (3 families) disaggregation with no data-dependent reweighting or learner/method switches.
decision_and_reporting_plan.simulation_policy: The single protein-structure simulation family is a separate secondary analysis for each learner. It cannot rescue a failed primary observational gate or be pooled into the primary regression mean.

family_harm.definition: Raw-baseline harm = L(candidate)/L(baseline) - 1. Flag strictly greater than 0.05; report analogous >5% harms against each strong reference separately.

decision_gate.mean_vs_raw: For EACH of the four primary task/learner strata, arithmetic mean G versus raw must be strictly > 0; primary-observational equal-family mean per learner must also be > 0.
decision_gate.family_harm: No scheduled family/learner may have >5% loss worsening versus raw, including the separately reported simulation family. The simulation remains outside primary mean/median aggregation and cannot rescue any primary stratum.
decision_gate.strong_reference_noninferiority: For EACH primary task/learner stratum and EACH of the two fixed strong references, arithmetic mean paired relative improvement G must be >= 0 on the complete preregistered paired-family set. Do not choose the easier reference after results.
decision_gate.completion: All 128 planned cells must be successful and finite for a broad planned-cohort claim. Any error, timeout, OOM, unsupported method, admission failure, missing pair, interruption or budget-exhaustion blocks broad superiority/promotion claims; report surviving complete-pair results only as scoped descriptive evidence.
decision_gate.zero_or_invalid_denominators: Do not inject epsilon denominators or drop families. Zero/nonfinite comparator losses make a ratio gate indeterminate and block its automatic pass; retain absolute losses and explain the limitation.
decision_gate.interpretation: Passing the predeclared operational gate supports at most a narrowly scoped result for this protocol and release candidate. It is neither a significance test nor a universal guarantee.

intervals.interpretation: Descriptive only, not a confirmatory p-value or proof of significance after development method selection.
intervals.method: Paired family-block percentile bootstrap of G within each primary task/learner stratum; resample whole families with all their paired methods/splits.
intervals.small_n: Primary regression contains only two families; its intervals are particularly unstable. A single simulation family has no meaningful between-family interval; report no fabricated one.

decision_and_reporting_plan.completion_and_resources: Report planned/succeeded/failed cells and complete paired families per method/task/learner, failure reasons, active wall time, per-cell timing, peak worker RSS and budget consumption. Failed references remain in denominators.
scope_limits: Only these 12 independently reserved project-model-unexposed source families, two learners and four named FE methods.
Ten official tasks use one predetermined repeat0/fold0/sample0 only; this is NOT the full repeated TabArena suite or its leaderboard protocol.
Two native UCI tasks use fixed 3-fold seed-2026 IID CV, not their source paper's original evaluation.
No all-modality, all-dataset or universal SOTA assertion; no automatic release/default promotion.
Original curation, duplicate, retrospective-label, uncertain-annotation and restricted-use caveats remain binding.

preregistration.method_selection_basis: One fixed existing method chosen by the user/parent from exposed-development work, not any reserved-family outcome. No per-family/task/learner method selection.

budget_accounting.note: Parent-supplied status/timing facts only; no development scores or confirmation outcomes were opened by this audit. Preparation overhead shares the 38h ceiling. No completion guarantee and no authority to exceed the original 72h allowance.

exposure_and_integrity.source_hash_scope: Recorded existing model/catalog files only, not a final aggregate execution fingerprint. The execution agent is adding protocol plumbing; parent must capture the final runtime snapshot after review.
exposure_and_integrity.privacy: No raw data, splits ARFF, labels, predictions, model output records, reports or score files were opened. Only already-approved metadata/primary-license pages and profile summaries were read.
exposure_and_integrity.rights_scope: Ten UCI CC-BY-4.0 origins, original collector CC0 Fiat table, and original donor CC-BY-SA microwave table. Existing local-only/no-conveyance restrictions remain; no LLM/cloud row transfer or redistribution is newly approved.

datasets.name: uci-heart-failure-clinical
datasets.prediction_time: Recorded death during the supplied follow-up from clinical measurements. Follow-up time is excluded as outcome-associated information; no uniform survival horizon or clinical deployment claim.

target_timing_review.task: Retrospective classification of the supplied patient-record outcome, with follow-up duration excluded; NOT an all-fields outcome classifier or an established baseline prognostic model.
target_timing_review.endpoint: death_event=1 means death occurred during that patient's recorded follow-up; 0 means no recorded death during that observation period, not indefinite survival.
target_timing_review.predictor_timing_limit: The primary dataset describes records collected during follow-up. Removing time does not prove every remaining clinical predictor was available at a common baseline; no such availability is claimed.
target_timing_review.survival_analysis_limit: No fixed prediction horizon, common follow-up window, censoring adjustment or time-to-event model is defined by this binary classification recipe.
